departments.name: Administration
departments.description: Administration oversees strategic planning, operational management, corporate compliance, financial controls, and inter-departmental coordination across all manufacturing and export divisions.
departments.short_description: Strategic planning, corporate compliance, and global operations management.

departments.name: Materials & Sourcing
departments.description: Responsible for evaluating, testing, and procuring top-tier technical fabrics, high-grade leather, moisture-wicking micro-polyester, and specialized threads from certified global mills.
departments.short_description: Procurement of technical fabrics, premium leather, and certified raw materials.

departments.name: Cutting & Pattern Making
departments.description: Computerized automatic laser cutting and CAD pattern grading ensuring 100% dimensional accuracy, zero fabric distortion, and optimized material consumption across all athletic sizes.
departments.short_description: CAD computerized automatic laser pattern cutting & multi-size grading.

departments.name: Production
departments.description: Advanced manufacturing facility equipped with heavy-duty Japanese automatic sewing machines for reinforced double stitching, flatlock seam assembly, and thermo-bonded panel joining.
departments.short_description: High-capacity garment assembly, stitching, and thermo-bonded manufacturing.

departments.name: Embellishment
departments.description: State-of-the-art Italian digital sublimation printers, multi-head Tajima embroidery machines, screen printing, 3D silicone badging, and metallic foil branding.
departments.short_description: Digital sublimation, multi-head embroidery, and 3D silicone badging.

departments.name: Quality Control
departments.description: Rigorous multi-stage quality control checking every seam, measurement, print accuracy, fabric elasticity, and finish before issuing final export release clearance.
departments.short_description: 100% piece-by-piece multi-stage quality inspection & lab testing.

departments.name: Packing & Dispatching
departments.description: Custom branded poly-bagging, silica desiccant inserts, barcode labeling, custom hangtags, and heavy-duty 7-ply corrugated export master cartoning.
departments.short_description: Custom poly-bagging, barcode tagging, and global export packaging.

departments.name: Research & Development
departments.description: Continuous innovation in moisture-wicking synthetic fabrics, high-impact shock-absorbing EVA foam padding, aerodynamic match ball surfaces, and athletic fits.
departments.short_description: Material science innovation, aerodynamic testing & athletic prototyping.
